cc:Work.dc:title: Every match, every outcome probability
cc:Work.dc:description: All held-out fixtures, sorted by group, date and match ID. H / D / A = listed home win / draw / listed away win. Numbers are forecast percentages; orange outlines mark the realized class. Home/away listing is not always venue advantage.
